header: Two to four routes to the right price list
lead: Each card carries an icon, a line of qualification and a link onward. There are deliberately no prices in this band.
note: The note is where what applies to every route goes — currency, region, tax basis.

routes.title: The audience is the title
routes.description: A reader should recognise themselves in it without reading the sentence below.

routes.title: The qualification is one line
routes.description: What makes this the right route: a size, a sector, a way of buying.

routes.title: The whole card is the target
routes.description: One link per card, wrapping the title, which is already the accessible name.
